security_privacy_cost_impact: Security: a local tool only; no grant, policy, role, schema or CI change. try-it makes a cluster outside the repository that listens on 127.0.0.1 only, over TCP, with no unix socket, and trusts local connections while it is up (any process on the machine can connect as the superuser; it holds synthetic fixtures only; TRY-IT.md says so; A1 owes the call on a per-cluster password, open_blockers[196] (2)). Every URL it builds passes the repository's testHostRefusal narrowed to loopback names and a non-reserved port; it refuses 5432 and the measurement ports; `down` deletes only a directory holding its marker and nothing but what `up` made. Privacy: synthetic fixtures only, no real data. Cost: none; no dependency, no service.
migration_and_data_impact: None. No migration file is added or edited. scripts/db/rls-smoke.mjs moves its helper and fixture loading, unchanged, into the exported loadHelpersAndFixtures(), which main() calls (rls-smoke 1087 cases, twice). db/foundation/lint/audit-coverage-map.json changes only its 33 blocker line fields (-1 each: the manifest's amendment list shrank by one line; indexes and quotes unchanged).
compatibility_impact: Tests stay 685 (no test added); foundation-contract's assertion floor 1044 -> 1074 (main counted 1054; 20 assertions added to the existing live-target refusal test); test floor and name digest unchanged; evidence/VERIFICATION.md unchanged. rls-smoke.mjs gains one export (loadHelpersAndFixtures). New: scripts/db/try-it.mjs, db/foundation/TRY-IT.md. No Makefile target or npm script (owed to the Integration Owner).
known_limitations: Measured on macOS (Darwin 25.6) with Homebrew PostgreSQL 17.11 and Node 24.20.0 only; Linux unmeasured, Windows not claimed (open_blockers[196] (3)).
The demo shows the database rules on a local copy: no app, no service-worker path (no app_worker step; open_blockers[113]), no provisioned Supabase instance; 13 representative checks, not the suite.
The demo's four counts steps pin today's fixture; CI holds the plan statically, not the counts live (open_blockers[196] (4)).
Trust auth on loopback while a cluster is up (open_blockers[196] (2)).
The other DB runners still enter main() by `file://${argv[1]}` (a clone path with a space); try-it does not (open_blockers[196] (5), read and not measured).
The cherry-picked draft commit's message says assertion floor 1014 -> 1030, true on 5bde893; on main the floor is 1074, set by 1298dbe.
